EXHIBIT A10Institutional Record(CLM-005)

WOW Parenting

School & Family Working as One: Learning Ends at Home

1. Overview & Definition

ACHARIYA's flagship parent-enablement initiative. Recognizes that educational transformation in the classroom is unsustainable without empathetic, conscious support in the family living room.

2. Conceptualization & Leadership

Conceived and designed by Dr. J. Arawindhan Ji since 2000; codified, tested, and scaled across campuses through the ACHARIYA Centre of Excellence (CoE) and faculty development academies.

3 & 4. Operational Mechanics & Core Principles

  • Workshops in Happy Parenting, Power Parenting, and Parenting Styles analysis.
  • Rich Mom and Enriching Mom/Dad community sessions.
  • Consciousness workshops to help parents maintain emotional pace with their evolving children.
  • Complemented by the published WOW Parenting handbook.

5. Implementation & Target Learners

Implemented across 101 ACHARIYA-affiliated schools, 18 higher education colleges, and 9 Heguru centres, catering to age groups spanning toddlerhood (6 months) through Grade 12.

6. Documented Evidence & Reach

  • Directly engaged and empowered over 10,000+ parents.
  • Formally integrated as an essential pillar of the 77 ConCardios training framework.
Factual Integrity & Scope Notes

Data points for this methodology are sourced directly from the official ACHARIYA portfolio dossier (Collection A) and internal Centre of Excellence SOP documentation. Quantitative claims are tracked under Claim ID CLM-005.
